subject: Fincore trial kickoff — scheduling & success criteria
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marta Gomez <marta@fincore.com>, Tom Blake <t.blake@fincore.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 20:15:00 +0000
Subject: Fincore trial kickoff — scheduling & success criteria

Hi Marta / Tom,

Thanks again for the call today — great conversation and I appreciate the clear priorities. Quick written recap and proposed next steps so we can lock in the trial kickoff and start the evaluation.

What I heard (summary)
- Primary objective: validate model latency and cost at 95th percentile for Fincore production prompts, and confirm inference quality on your top-50 prompt set.
- Constraints: data residency in US, limited PII in test payloads, vendor security questionnaire in parallel.
- Success signals you mentioned: <= 250ms median token latency for 512-token runs, under $0.003 per 1k tokens on batch profile, parity on entity extraction accuracy vs current baseline.

Proposed trial kickoff windows (pick one)
- Wed Apr 1, 2026 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu Apr 2, 2026 — 13:00–14:00 PT
- Mon Apr 6, 2026 — 09:00–10:00 PT

Kickoff agenda (30–45m)
- 10m: Trial plan & logistics (trial duration, credentials, data handling)
- 15–20m: Technical deep dive / demo (Laura to cover runtime + model variants)
- 10m: Success criteria / prompt set and next steps (assign owners)

What I need from you before we schedule
- Preferred kickoff time from the three options above
- Final list of attendees (names + roles)
- Share the 50 prompt examples you want in the eval (if you can attach them or share a Drive link)

I attached a short trial plan (fincore-trial-plan-v1.pdf) with proposed duration and provisioning; treat it as draft.

Once we pick a slot I will:
- Send calendar invite with dial-in + agenda
- Loop in Laura Bennett (SE) to prepare the technical checklist and demo variants
- Open a trial project and pre-provision capacity so we can start immediately after kickoff

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com

Thanks Vivek — this looks good. We can do Wed Apr 1 at 10:00 PT. Confirming attendees:
- Marta Gomez — Head of Data Science
- Tom Blake — Lead ML Eng
- Priya (QA) — will be on the evaluation side (I will add her to the invite once I have her calendar)

Initial success criteria from our side (high level):
- Measure latency on our top-50 prompts (as discussed) and compare to our current endpoint (95th pct target)
- Evaluate hallucination rate for entity extraction across the same prompts
- Basic cost projection for 1M monthly tokens at measured throughput

We will share the prompt set (CSV) and a short sample dataset by EOD Mon Mar 29. Tom is keen on a technical deep dive during the kickoff — he wants to see batching behavior, GPU/CPU plot, and any KV caching options.

Please go ahead and send the calendar invite for Apr 1 10:00 PT and loop in the SE who will demo.

Thanks,
Marta

Perfect — thanks Marta. I'll lock Apr 1 10:00 PT and send the invite in a minute. Quick notes / who's doing what: 

- Vivek (me): calendar + kickoff agenda, coordinate trial provisioning and contract questions; point of contact for the engagement.
- Laura Bennett (SE, cc'd): technical deep dive & demo; please prepare a 15–20m demo that covers:
  * batching trade-offs and example latency numbers for 512-token runs
  * GPU backend variants we'll propose (quantized vs FP16) and expected throughput
  * KV/prefix caching demo if feasible with Fincore prompts
- Rachel Kim (cc'd): will own trial provisioning, access, and billing details (trial credits / capacity).

Action items for Fincore before kickoff:
- Send prompt set CSV + small sample dataset (Priya is fine to share)
- Confirm any extra attendees (add to the invite)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Cc: rachel_kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 15:00:00 +0000
Subject: [Internal] Prep for Fincore Apr 1 kickoff

Laura — quick internal note ahead of the kickoff on Thu: please prepare the following items for the demo and send any slides or checklist by EOD Wed (Mar 31):

1) Short slides (5–7) covering runtime architecture and model variants we'll test (include expected perf numbers).
2) Demo script: show one live prompt from their sample set, then a 5-run batching comparison (1, 4, 8 concurrency) — capture p50/p95 latencies.
3) KV/prefix caching demo: if we can show a 2x reduction in repeated-token cost that would be great.
4) Quick slide on quantization recommendations and any expected accuracy delta.
5) A list of any tech blockers that would prevent us from starting trial work within 48 hours post-kickoff (e.g., IP/consent docs, dataset redaction needs).

Rachel — please confirm trial project name and that we have the capacity reserve for a 2-week trial using a small Dedicated pool (I will need the project id to put in the calendar invite).

Thanks — keep it tight, this is a short kickoff.

Vivek
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
